title: Plumeform integrations flow (v2)
description: On paper: heading at the left, explanation and an underlined link at the right. Below, a glass panel in warm fog (a sample reply) sends dashed teal curves fanning out to a column of near-white glass cards, one per destination, each with a line icon, a bold name, an optional PLUS badge, a quiet detail at the right and a line of status text. Two rows of small grey pills (export formats, ways to share) close it. Panels and cards rise and un-blur in turn; on phones the curves give way to a plain stack.
notes: the source panel is a slot (a live form or a screenshot), a placeholder when empty
